requirements.description: Annual Compustat fundamentals required for the rolling cross-sectional HVZ, EP and RI earnings-forecasting regressions, including all outcome and predictor fields.

required_coverage.frequency: annual statements; bounds use calendar years of actual DATADATE
required_coverage.population: Annual Compustat firms entering the model’s ten-year rolling training cross-sections; selected forecast-origin fits are 1969–2012.
required_coverage.detail: Forecast origins1969–2012 use ten inclusive training-outcome labels t−9..t (108 months of endpoint gap). Horizon3 adds36 months to reach predictor label t−12. Source page7 maps analytical label y to actual FYEs April(y−1)..March(y), adding12 months of raw calendar-date coverage; AC/TACC annual differences add another12 months. The longest composed lookback is108+36+12+12=168 months, producing raw calendar envelope1955–2012. At first origin1969, earliest predictor label1957 has dates in1956/1957, while prior AC/TACC statement label1956 has dates in1955/1956. No future outcome after2012 is required to fit the assigned historical coefficients.

routes.mapping_notes: Catalog field labels directly match the paper’s named Xpressfeed/Compustat annual items (AT, DVC, IB, SPI, CSHO, ACT, CHE, LCT, DLC, TXP, DP, CEQ, IVAO, LT, IVST and PSTK). The current file is a revised vintage, but no numeric historical Compustat item remapping is inferred. Appendix1 RI components also explicitly name DLTT. Retain it for the source’s component calculations and missing-value policy, even though its numeric terms can cancel in a fully observed total-accrual sum.
routes.coverage_notes: An exact-resource probe supports bounded readability and the listed live columns. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this study period and target population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation supports this local snapshot for the required historical population; route completeness therefore remains undetermined.

design_coverage.reason: For Table 1, estimate annual cross-sectional fits for forecast-origin years 1969–2012 using the horizon-specific prior-ten-year training windows; at each June 30 fit, include firm fiscal years ending April of t−1 through March of t and exclude April–June of t as unavailable. No regression weights are reported for the selected baseline fits.
The source identifies OLS for the base cross-sectional equations; robust regression is a sensitivity alternative and is not the frozen baseline.
Winsorize all variables annually at the 1st/99th percentiles and replace missing AC/TACC with zero as stated for the model estimation sample.

Annual Compustat records are keyed by GVKEY and fiscal datadate; no CRSP/IBES join is required for the frozen Table 1 cross-sectional coefficient fits.
No fixed-effect family is reported for the annual cross-sectional baseline equations.
The table reports time-series t-statistics across annual coefficient estimates; the paper does not specify a cluster-robust standard-error procedure for the annual cross-sectional fits.
No regression weights are reported for the selected baseline fits.
The source identifies OLS for the base cross-sectional equations; robust regression is a sensitivity alternative and is not the frozen baseline.
Winsorize all variables annually at the 1st/99th percentiles and replace missing AC/TACC with zero as stated for the model estimation sample.

implementation_issues.description: The frozen Table 1 coefficient results use annual forecasts through origin year 2012. Current Compustat vintages may revise older statements; no coordinator confirmation establishes coverage of the required 1955–2012 rolling training envelope.

review_notes: Source correction: the selected Table 1 baseline coefficient fits use forecast-origin years 1969–2012; the sample extraction’s 1969–2008 window describes forecast-performance evaluation and is not substituted for those fits.

Raw Compustat coverage is conservatively extended to 1955–2012 from the training-row universe: 10-year outcome windows plus up to a three-year predictor lag and one inner year for AC/TACC changes. The horizon is not applied to the final origin year to invent post-2012 outcomes.
